notes: File name of #20 says 1932, but the date field and the ETH negative (9.9.34) give 9 September 1934. Merian’s plate (#9) is from Topographia Provinciarum Austriacarum, 1649, so it falls in P1 with the colored Braun and Hogenberg plate preferred; it also has the book gutter through the view. Jakob Alt’s 1845 watercolor of the Golden Roof and town tower (#11) is a strong color alternative for P3. Brennerbahn album photo #19 skipped: album undated. #3/#4 (vol. 5) show the Inn valley and a text page, not the town.
